Deterministic from a round seed. Multi-hole ROUND_PLANS pacing (9-hole loop).
mulberry32 + namespaced forking. ?seed= URL support, shareable seed strings. THE RULE: no Math.random() in generation/physics.
Power -> accuracy -> strike. Timing error -> mishits (pull/push, thin/fat), graded pure/good/poor/terrible. Pure module (no THREE/DOM).
Driver..Lob+Putter, each with launch profile + variants (full/punch/flop/chip). estimateDistance + autoSelectClub(dist, onGreen, lie). Loft slider is GONE.
rough/bunker penalties (speed, spin, launch, dir noise). getLieAt(terrain,pos).
Replaces stringly-typed state bugs. Throws on unknown states.
2 InstancedMeshes (trunk+canopy) = 2 draw calls for the whole forest. Trunk colliders registered on terrain for ball physics.

Blocker.Symptom: npm run dev fails: "cannon-es could not be resolved (imported by _archive/cannonDebug.html)".
Blocker.Cause: The _archive/ folder (dead cannon demo files) is inside the project root, so Vite's dep scanner walks it.
Blocker.Fix: Move _archive/ OUT of the Vite project root (e.g. to a sibling dir), OR add it to vite.config.js server.watch.ignored / optimizeDeps.exclude, OR delete it if the cannon demos are truly unwanted. Verify dev boots clean afterward.

Blocker.Symptom: Large uncommitted working tree; the entire overhaul + deploy fixes are uncommitted.
Blocker.Cause: Work was done across sessions without committing.
Blocker.Fix: Commit the working tree in logical chunks (see Execution/CommitPlan) BEFORE doing more. You need a clean rollback point.

Verification.Step: 1. Fix B1, then `npm run dev` and open http://localhost:3000.
2. Play one full hole: title -> aim (camera faces hole; club auto-selected) -> 3-click swing -> watch flight -> land -> roll -> next lie.
3. Sink a ball: confirm the white cup + sink animation fire.
4. Advance to hole 2: confirm loadHole(n) regenerates a DIFFERENT archetype and the old hole's meshes are disposed.
5. Set ?seed=TEST-1234, reload, play hole 1, reload again -> the SAME hole must regenerate (determinism check).
6. Open browser console; set window.DEBUG=true; reload; watch for warnings (embedded ball, off-screen, NaN heights).
Verification.FailureMode: If dev works but build differs, suspect _archive or an import that bundler resolves differently.

Architecture.Principle: Keep core/ and course/ PURE: no THREE, no DOM, no timers. They are data + functions. This makes them testable and reusable.
The seeded rng is the source of truth. Never Math.random() in generation/physics. Cosmetic-only may fork a stream.
One hole per 400x400 tile. Tee west, green east. Play flows along spec.path.
The fitness function must never be bypassed. If designHole returns bestEffort, log it — that's a bug in the generator, not a feature.
Use the StateMachine (core/states.js), not ad-hoc string states. Adding a state means declaring it up front.
Architecture.GodObjectWarning: game.js is still large. As features land, extract controllers (RoundController, InputController, CameraDirector). Do not let it grow further.
